entries.brief: One original SKAZ D&D 5e2014 spell icon. Classic painterly fantasy reference-book illustration, serious naturalistic materials, muted colors, soft warm key light, neutral shadows. Not cartoon, no emoji faces, no chibi. Strong compact silhouette at32px, transparent RGBA background, square canvas, subject75% canvas with clear15% margin. No text, letters, frame, watermark, scenery or diffuse outer bloom. A stern bronze human face-mask beneath a poised hand whose three violet luminous threads connect directly to the mask. Symbol of direct mental command over one humanoid, no footsteps, no injury. Broad geometric mask distinct from sculpted confusion head.

review.notes: Local IAB32/40px, grayscale circle, Polaris/Coal/Atlas. Six final motifs inspected at32/40px in all themes and gray circles. Fabricate is distinct from Creation; stationary spectral guard dog; alternative warm and cold flames.
